description: China High Speed Railways and Stations (2016) is a data set deposited in Harvard Dataverse by its authors Yifan Li. Stations and Lines of China's High Speed Railway System, circa 2016. Revised from a previous version (circa 2014) based on publicly available system schedules, news items, and locations found using Google Earth and Open Street Map. Compiled by Yifan Li, revised by Lex Berman, edited with revisions by Xuan Zhang. Browse webmap: http://worldmap.harvard.edu/maps/chinamap/WDv. Coverage: national (CN); the metadata date the deposit to 2016. Formats: PDF, ZIP. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC0 1.0. Caveats: written from the Dataverse search and dataset metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-hdv-repository.
